verses.gurmukhi: ਕਛੂ ਬੱਚਾ ਨਦੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: kachhoo ba'chaa nadhee vich gursikh lahar na bhavajal biaapai|

en.bdb: As the offspring of tortoise are not affected by sea waves so is the case of the Sikhs of Guru; they are not influenced by the waves of the World Ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੰਜ ਬੱਚਾ ਲੈਇ ਉਡਰੈ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: koo(n)j ba'chaa lai uddarai su(n)n samaadh agaadh na jaapai|

en.bdb: Florican bird flies comfortably along with its offspring in the sky but the sky does not look abysmal to it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਵੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਨਸਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: ha(n)s va(n)s hai maanasar sahaj sarovar vadd parataapai|

en.bdb: The progeny of swans reside in the all potent Manasarovar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੱਤਕ ਬੱਚਾ ਕੋਇਲੈ ਨੰਦ ਨੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਮਿਲਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: ba'tak ba'chaa koilai na(n)dh na(n)dhan vaasudhev milaapai|

en.bdb: The goose and nightingale separate their progeny from hens and crows respectively and though living among milkman Krishna ultimately went to Vasudev; likewise, the gurmukh giving up all the evil propensities goes to merge in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਚਕਵੀ ਤੈ ਚਕੋਰ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਲੰਘਿ ਵਰੈ ਸਰਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: rav sas chakavee tai chakor siv sakatee la(n)gh varai saraapai|

en.bdb: As the female ruddy sheldrake and redlegged partridge meet sun and moon respectively gurmukh also crossing the maya of Siva and Sakti attains the highest state of equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਲ ਪੰਖਿ ਬੱਚਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਸਮਝੈ ਆਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: anal pa(n)kh ba'chaa milai niraadhaar hoi samajhai aapai|

en.bdb: The anal bird recognises its offspring even without any basis for its identification.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾਇ ਪਛਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh sa(n)dh milaavanee sabadh surat parachai pachhaapai|

en.bdb: It is the state of Sikh who merging his consciousness in the Word, identifies the true love (of the Lord).
The gurmukhs identify and establish the fruits of delight.
